description: Complete field-level before/after ledger for the Phase 3 card catalog pass.

changes.name: Air Horn
changes.after: The Department recognizes one volume: procedurally deafening.

changes.name: Bad Habit
changes.after: Five copies were required. Improvement remains optional.

changes.name: Banana Peel
changes.after: Approved floor hazard. Peel filed separately.

changes.name: Bandages
changes.after: Apply pressure, then apply three forms in triplicate.

changes.name: Basic Body Kick
changes.after: The middle-management kick of middle-targeted kicking.

changes.name: Basic Jab
changes.after: Short, direct, and still awaiting committee embellishment.

changes.name: Basic Shin Kick
changes.after: Aim low. Expectations have already been adjusted.

changes.name: Body Shield
changes.after: The shield covers everything except the carrying permit.

changes.name: Boxing Gloves
changes.after: The clearance sticker adds no Guard but tremendous confidence.

changes.name: Breathing Drill
changes.after: Inhale courage. Exhale a modest damage modifier.

changes.name: Bubble Wrap
changes.after: Every bubble is a tiny safety inspector doing its best.

changes.name: Bubble Wrap Gi
changes.after: The uniform crackles with certified personal space.

changes.name: Buckler
changes.after: A small shield for a fighter with very specific concerns.

changes.name: Caffeinated Mochi
changes.after: Two cards now. A responsible bedtime never.

changes.name: Cardboard Chestplate
changes.after: Rated for two impacts or one determined raccoon.

changes.name: Cardboard Cutout of Yourself
changes.after: The likeness is uncanny from across a poorly lit dojo.

changes.name: Center Guard
changes.after: Protect the center. The edges have signed waivers.

changes.name: Chest Protector
changes.after: Actual protective equipment wandered into the wrong game.

changes.name: Confetti Cannon
changes.after: The official response to a carefully timed objection.

changes.name: Cookie Sheet Bracer
changes.after: Oven-safe, Weapon-resistant, and banned from three potlucks.

changes.name: Cover Up
changes.after: When technique fails, become approximately turtle-shaped.

changes.name: Dojo Coupon
changes.after: Not valid with dignity, cash, or participating dojos.

changes.name: Dojo Door
changes.after: The exit was removed for combat efficiency.

changes.name: Dojo Folding Mat
changes.after: Fold once for storage. Fold twice for plausible self-defense.

changes.name: Electrolyte Popsicle
changes.after: Hydration achieved. Restraint postponed.

changes.name: Emergency Burrito
changes.after: Emergency in. Initiative out.

changes.name: Emergency Clipboard
changes.after: The clipboard has reviewed your Attack and found it incomplete.

changes.name: Emergency Exit Sign
changes.after: The glowing arrow points toward a legally defensible retreat.

changes.name: Emergency Ice Pack
changes.after: Cold enough to heal. Official enough to sting.

changes.name: Emergency Shoelace
changes.after: A double knot defeats one highly specific tragedy.

changes.name: Emotional Support Pillow
changes.after: Licensed for comfort, impact reduction, and difficult rounds.

changes.name: Energy Gel of Questionable Origin
changes.after: The label lists courage between glucose and possible regret.

changes.name: Expired Protein Shake
changes.after: Best before yesterday. Strongest immediately before consequences.

changes.name: Final Boss
changes.after: The final form has a second final form. Budget approved.

changes.name: Foam Finger
changes.after: Choose a zone and point with unreasonable authority.

changes.name: Foot Guards
changes.after: The toes are protected. Their career prospects are not.

changes.name: Footwork Drill
changes.after: Move first. Explain the foot-shaped paperwork later.

changes.name: Forearm Guards
changes.after: For blocking forearms and absolutely no follow-up questions.

changes.name: Fortune Cookie
changes.after: The message reads: reorder responsibly, fight irresponsibly.

changes.name: Fresh Fruit
changes.after: The Department briefly remembers nutrition exists.

changes.name: Fresh Martial Arts Gi
changes.after: Fresh uniform. Previous mistakes sold separately.

changes.name: Green Tea
changes.after: Steep three minutes. Reconsider one card.

changes.name: Groin Guard
changes.after: Required by safety policy and the continued existence of low kicks.

changes.name: Helmet Made of Smaller Helmets
changes.after: Each smaller helmet supervises a different thought.

changes.name: Herbal Tea
changes.after: Calm in a cup. Administrative filtering in the leaves.

changes.name: High Guard
changes.after: Hands up. Standards marginally higher.

changes.name: Ice Pack
changes.after: The bench requested six cubes and a less embarrassing story.

changes.name: Inflatable Sumo Suit
changes.after: A majestic monument to defense and reduced mobility.

changes.name: Instant Noodles
changes.after: Ready in three minutes, strategically regretted in two.

changes.name: Kendo Do
changes.after: Traditional protection with a modern Speed complaint.

changes.name: Kendo Men
changes.after: Excellent head protection. Terrible peripheral paperwork.

changes.name: Knee Pads
changes.after: Your knees survive. Your entrance does not.

changes.name: Kombucha
changes.after: Fermentation accomplished what discipline could not.

changes.name: Kote
changes.after: The wrists have entered a formal nonaggression agreement.

changes.name: Layers of Hoodies
changes.after: Four hoods, eight sleeves, one unresolved laundry dispute.

changes.name: Leather Bracers
changes.after: The bracers are genuine. The warranty uses the word 'mostly.'

changes.name: Low Guard
changes.after: Protect the foundation. Complain about shin bruises afterward.

changes.name: Lucky Dumpling
changes.after: Luck is just quality control with crumbs inside.

changes.name: Mini-Boss
changes.after: Important enough for a title. Not important enough for the final music.

changes.name: Mom's Tupperware Lid
changes.after: Return it clean or face a Boss the rules cannot contain.

changes.name: Mouthguard
changes.after: Protects teeth, dignity, and several expensive consonants.

changes.name: Muscle Ointment
changes.after: Rub vigorously until the drawback stops reading the card.

changes.name: Muscle Relaxant
changes.after: Everything relaxes, including the next offensive plan.

changes.name: Museum Rope Barrier
changes.after: Please remain behind the velvet line while being attacked.

changes.name: Mystery Dojo Jerky
changes.after: Ingredients: protein, smoke, and a legally distinct growl.

changes.name: No Soliciting Sign
changes.after: Solicitors, attackers, and destiny must knock elsewhere.

changes.name: Padded Gi
changes.after: Comfortable, washable, spiritually judgmental.

changes.name: Painkiller
changes.after: The bruise remains; its scheduling authority has been reduced.

changes.name: Participation Trophy Shield
changes.after: Awarded for appearing near danger with both hands visible.

changes.name: Phone Book Chest Guard
changes.after: Somewhere, 1998 has become protective equipment.

changes.name: Plum Wine
changes.after: Confidence rises. Defensive judgment leaves by the side door.

changes.name: Pocket Sand
changes.after: Ancient desert technique. Modern janitorial violation.

changes.name: Pool Noodle Shield
changes.after: The shield bends. The insult remains rigid.

changes.name: Reflective Safety Vest
changes.after: Aggressively visible and therefore tactically inconvenient.

changes.name: Rival
changes.after: A personal grudge with entry-level management authority.

changes.name: Rubber Chicken
changes.after: Nobody can file an objection while the chicken is testifying.

changes.name: Seaweed Wrap
changes.after: Restorative, defensive, and unreasonably expensive at the spa dojo.

changes.name: Sensei's Advice
changes.after: The advice was free. Removing the habit costs one card.

changes.name: Sensei's Disapproving Stare
changes.after: No batteries. Infinite disappointment.

changes.name: Shin Guards
changes.after: The shin has retained legal representation.

changes.name: Smoke Bomb
changes.after: Disappear in a cloud of smoke and incomplete incident reports.

changes.name: Spare Wrap
changes.after: One more wrap between you and a deeply educational bruise.

changes.name: Sparring Dummy
changes.after: It never complains, which violates the instructor handbook.

changes.name: Sparring Headgear
changes.after: Spar responsibly. Nod carefully.

changes.name: Spinach
changes.after: The can promised muscles. The Attack accepted the affidavit.

changes.name: Sports Drink
changes.after: Official flavor: blue. Official result: faster yelling.

changes.name: Stunt Double
changes.after: Fully insured and professionally surprised.

changes.name: Sweat Towel
changes.after: The towel has absorbed sweat, doubt, and one point of Focus.

changes.name: Sweatband
changes.after: The sweat is now organized around a central mission.

changes.name: Taekwondo Hogu
changes.after: Tournament-grade protection with paperwork-grade ventilation.

changes.name: Tiger Balm
changes.after: Smells like victory and a strongly worded herbal memo.

changes.name: Traffic Cone Helmet
changes.after: Certified visible from three zones and one municipal intersection.

changes.name: Trash Can Lid
changes.after: Yesterday's garbage. Today's audited defense budget.

changes.name: Vitamins
changes.after: Five HP and one card closer to expensive confidence.

changes.name: Water Balloon
changes.after: The splash is temporary. The slow-motion betrayal is forever.

changes.name: Water Bottle
changes.after: Plain water passed inspection on its third appeal.

changes.name: Weighted Vest
changes.after: One XP awarded for carrying your own terrible idea.

changes.name: Wild Swing
changes.after: A complete tactical plan with the zone left blank.

changes.name: X-Ray Paper
changes.after: The attacker saw bones, panicked, and struck the paperwork.

changes.name: Yoga Mat Cape
changes.after: The cape billowed. The Speed penalty lost jurisdiction.

changes.name: Yoyo
changes.after: It went down, came back, and brought a complaint about Guard.

changes.name: Baseball Bat
changes.before: "Swing for the fences… or, you know, just knock their teeth out."
changes.after: Reclassified from sports equipment after the third parking-lot demonstration.

changes.name: Bo Staff (Long Staff)
changes.before: "If you can master this, you’ll look like a martial arts movie star. If not… well, it’s a long walk home."
changes.after: Long reach, upright posture, and one endangered ceiling tile.

changes.name: Bo-Shuriken (Throwing Spikes)
changes.before: "Not a main weapon, but certainly a helpful sidekick for that surprise backstab."
changes.after: Small enough to misplace. Sharp enough to trigger an inventory audit.

changes.name: Bokken (Wooden Sword)
changes.before: "It’s not real, but it sure feels like it when you hit something."
changes.after: Wooden, honest, and still capable of ending the seminar early.

changes.name: Brass Knuckles
changes.before: "Who needs a fancy blade when you’ve got pure punch power?"
changes.after: Four rings, one permit, zero subtle follow-up questions.

changes.name: Broken Bottle
changes.before: "Shattered dreams, shattered glass, and maybe a few fingers…"
changes.after: The recycling bin has declined responsibility.

changes.name: Bruce Lee's Nunchaku
changes.before: "Master Lee would approve... if you could handle the speed without breaking a bone."
changes.after: Purchased beside the keychains. Demonstrated far from the glassware.

changes.name: Butterfly Knife (Balisong)
changes.before: "One flip, and you're the coolest fighter in the room. The other flip... well, now you're just bleeding."
changes.after: Every flip is an argument against unsupervised confidence.

changes.name: Chain Whip
changes.before: "A line of metal segments powered entirely by bad ideas."
changes.after: A line of metal segments powered entirely by bad ideas.

changes.name: Club
changes.before: "It’s like hitting someone with a small tree. Who needs subtlety when you’ve got this much brute force?"
changes.after: A small tree with a shorter appeals process.

changes.name: Dao (Chinese Saber)
changes.before: "One edge, many opinions."
changes.after: One edge, many opinions, all entered into evidence.

changes.name: Deer Horn Knives
changes.before: "Circular blades for people who looked at normal knives and said 'too straightforward.'"
changes.after: Normal knives were rejected for insufficient administrative curvature.

changes.name: Dojo Mop
changes.before: "Sweep the leg. Then sweep the floor."
changes.after: Sweep the leg. Then sweep the floor. Inspection is Thursday.

changes.name: Dragon Sword
changes.before: "A sword forged in fire… now just don’t burn yourself on it."
changes.after: The dragon is decorative. The fire code is not.

changes.name: Eko Bo (Short Staff)
changes.before: "You may not have the reach, but you’ll have speed, and that’s enough to annoy anyone."
changes.after: Less reach, more speed, same endangered ceiling tile.

changes.name: Eku (Okinawan Oar)
changes.before: "It was an oar until somebody got creative."
changes.after: It was an oar until somebody discovered a paperwork loophole.

changes.name: Emotional Support Brick
changes.before: "Heavy, dependable, and always there when you need to process something."
changes.after: Heavy, dependable, and present for every difficult combat phase.

changes.name: Escrima Sticks
changes.before: "Two sticks. Infinite bruises. Minimal explanation."
changes.after: Two sticks. Infinite bruises. One very calm instructor.

changes.name: Fan (Tessen)
changes.before: "Who needs a sword when you’ve got the art of distraction? Nothing says ‘I’m in charge’ like a folding fan."
changes.after: A folding fan for cooling tempers and redirecting them toward High zone.

changes.name: Folding Chair of Destiny
changes.before: "Somewhere, a wrestling announcer just screamed."
changes.after: The chair was not invited. Destiny brought its own ticket.

changes.name: Frozen Burrito
changes.before: "Weaponized dinner. Eventually just dinner."
changes.after: Weaponized dinner. Eventually just dinner.

changes.name: Giant Foam Finger
changes.before: "We're number one! At extremely soft violence."
changes.after: We're number one at extremely soft violence.

changes.name: Gladius
changes.before: "Fast, focused, and ready to pierce through anyone who gets in your way."
changes.after: Compact, direct, and registered under 'historical demonstration concerns.'

changes.name: Grandma's Wooden Spoon
changes.before: "No martial art prepared you for that look."
changes.after: No martial art prepared you for that look.

changes.name: Hand Axe
changes.before: "For when cutting down trees is too boring. This axe is made for more… personal work."
changes.after: The forestry permit has been redacted for tournament use.

changes.name: Hook Swords
changes.before: "Swords with hooks, because ordinary swords lacked paperwork."
changes.after: Ordinary swords lacked enough ways to catch on the safety rope.

changes.name: Jian (Straight Sword)
changes.before: "Elegant enough for poetry. Sharp enough to end the poem early."
changes.after: Elegant enough for poetry. Sharp enough to require a shorter stanza.

changes.name: Jo Staff (Short Staff)
changes.before: "Small and nimble—great for dodging, bad for blocking."
changes.after: Short staff. Long explanation. Medium ceiling damage.

changes.name: Kali Sticks (Arnis)
changes.before: "Faster than your brain can register, and definitely not good for your face."
changes.after: The sticks arrived in pairs because one complaint was insufficient.

changes.name: Kama (Sickle)
changes.before: "The harvest has come, and it’s in the form of sharp blades cutting through anyone standing in your way."
changes.after: Agricultural heritage meets a venue manager's worst afternoon.

changes.name: Kampalan (Southeast Asian Weapon)
changes.before: "Big, heavy, and guaranteed to break something."
changes.after: The form listed its weight as 'several consequences.'

changes.name: Karambit (Hooked Dagger)
changes.before: "This one’s all about that hook-and-pull. Not just for disemboweling… but for setting the mood."
changes.after: The hook is practical. The confidence attached to it is not.

changes.name: Katana (Japanese Sword)
changes.before: "Elegance, power, and a whole lot of cutting things in one shiny package."
changes.after: Polished, balanced, and accompanied by a twelve-page display waiver.

changes.name: Kris (Curved Dagger)
changes.before: "Curved for your cutting pleasure—watch out, it’s got a wicked twist."
changes.after: The blade bends. The incident report does not.

changes.name: Kubotan
changes.before: "Tiny stick, enormous confidence."
changes.after: Tiny stick, enormous confidence, accessory-sized insurance premium.

changes.name: Kunai (Throwing Knives)
changes.before: "Toss them, stick them, or just look ridiculously cool while you’re doing it. Either way, you win."
changes.after: Throw responsibly. Retrieve before the inspector counts them.

changes.name: Meteor Hammer
changes.before: "Some weapons have a learning curve. This one has an orbital path."
changes.after: Some weapons have a learning curve. This one has an orbital filing path.

changes.name: Miyagi-Do Karate Stick
changes.before: "It’s more than just a stick. It’s a lesson in patience, followed by a swift kick to the face."
changes.after: Patience is the first lesson. Moving your fingers is the second.

changes.name: Naginata (Polearm)
changes.before: "Think of it as the Swiss Army knife of polearms—long reach, short patience."
changes.after: Long reach, short patience, excellent visibility on the risk register.

changes.name: Nunchaku
changes.before: "It’s not just a weapon, it’s a test of patience... and probably your own coordination."
changes.after: A coordination exam disguised as two sticks and a chain.

changes.name: Pocket Stick
changes.before: "For when you need something small, sharp, and super sneaky."
changes.after: Pocket-sized authority for full-sized questionable decisions.

changes.name: Pool Noodle of Shame
changes.before: "The bruise heals. The disrespect is permanent."
changes.after: The bruise heals. The disrespect remains on permanent record.

changes.name: Qiang (Spear)
changes.before: "Keep your enemies close? Whoever said that did not own a spear."
changes.after: Keep your enemies at the distance specified by municipal ordinance.

changes.name: Rolled-Up Rulebook
changes.before: "Technically, page 17 says I can hit you with page 17."
changes.after: Page seventeen authorizes exactly this much procedural force.

changes.name: Rope Dart
changes.before: "This weapon’s dangerous, flexible, and will likely tangle you in the process."
changes.after: Flexible, dangerous, and already tangled around the demonstration permit.

changes.name: Sai (Trident)
changes.before: "Three prongs of pain—because two just weren’t enough."
changes.after: Three prongs because the approval form had three signature lines.

changes.name: Scythe
changes.before: "A weapon made for harvesting souls… or maybe just a really bad day at the office."
changes.after: The groundskeeping department would like its dramatic silhouette back.

changes.name: Sectional Staff
changes.before: "It’s like a staff, but cooler. Just make sure you’re not using it on someone who doesn’t deserve it."
changes.after: A staff with extra joints and no interest in workplace ergonomics.

changes.name: Short Sword
changes.before: "Quick, precise, and definitely not for long-range fights."
changes.after: Quick, precise, and filed under 'please stand closer.'

changes.name: Shuriken (Throwing Stars)
changes.before: "They're small, they're sharp, and they'll definitely stab your ego when you miss."
changes.after: Small, sharp, and extremely embarrassing to retrieve after a miss.

changes.name: Staff of Master Shifu
changes.before: "Master the staff. Master your destiny. Or just whack someone with it."
changes.after: Its lineage is ancient, prestigious, and unavailable for verification.

changes.name: Tactical Baguette
changes.before: "Fresh baked. Combat stale."
changes.after: Fresh baked. Combat stale. Crumbs legally inadmissible.

changes.name: Tanto (Dagger)
changes.before: "It’s small, it’s deadly, and it’s **perfect for quick, final touches."
changes.after: A small blade for quick corrections and very careful punctuation.

changes.name: Tekko (Brass Knuckles)
changes.before: "Because who needs a weapon when you’ve got fists of fury?"
changes.after: The fists requested a budget increase and received metal instead.

changes.name: Tonfa (Police Baton)
changes.before: "Not just for keeping the peace, but for giving your enemies a rude awakening."
changes.after: Keeps the peace by moving it three feet to the left.

changes.name: Traffic Cone
changes.before: "Safety equipment has chosen violence."
changes.after: Safety equipment has chosen violence and retained counsel.

changes.name: Whip
changes.before: "The crack heard ‘round the world... usually followed by a gasp and a fainted opponent."
changes.after: The crack is audible from the appeals office.

changes.name: Yo-Yo
changes.before: "You think it’s just a toy? WRONG. It’s a game-changer when used with the right flair."
changes.after: The toy returned with one Attack Bonus and no proof of purchase.

changes.before: Bruce Lee's Nunchaku
changes.after: Museum-Gift Nunchaku
changes.reason: Remove real-person reference and make the card original
